title: Five Tuk-Tuks and a Load of Bananas: How Twiga Foods Began
conflicts: Start date: How we made it in Africa (2016) says work began in November 2013; Business Daily (2017) says launch in November 2014; IFC, The Standard and others say founded 2014. Used 2014. Total funding: $185.4m in tech-ish, Techweez and The Condia's body text vs 'nearly $200 million' in The Condia's headline; used about $185m. Job cuts: tech-ish 283 (2023), 59 (2024), 300+ (2025) vs The Condia 319 of 435 (2025) and a workforce drop from 3,104 to about 2,097; story says only 'several rounds' and 'hundreds of people'. Vendor and farmer counts vary by year; story uses only the 2016 vendor figure and the 17,000 farmers given by both Business Daily (2019) and IFC (2020).
notes: Story ends with the August 2026 administration of GT Flow (formerly Twiga Foods One), stated factually with no cause attributed, since neither the company nor the administrator has given one. Quote stance 'complicates'. Founding details such as Brooke's red Toyota and Njonjo's scepticism are left out because their pages (TechCabal, Nation) could not be read.
